name: gamez_zbd_read_node_table
description: GameZ_ZBD::ReadNodeTable allocates and reads the serialized node table, restores per-node DI references and class data, marks active nodes, and repopulates world light/sound class-data caches.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass ZBD/source-cluster pass.

Binary Ninja still records a limited reconstruction marker because the larger ZBD node-table path includes allocation growth and post-pass cache repair; assembly, dependency frontier, and targeted smoke coverage support tier C equivalence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x455350 validates zero-count return, node-array malloc/realloc, zeroing newly grown slots, fread of 0xc4-byte node slots, zDi::IndexToPtrOrNull restoration, actionCallback clearing, ReadSingleNodeClassData dispatch, active-count/freeTag updates, world type-list traversal, and light/sound class-data cache repair.

The native node-table smoke verifies table allocation, active-count and freeTag updates, actionCallback clearing, world/light/sound class-data loads, restored world light/sound node lists, light/sound class-data cache arrays, and world type-list insertion.
